notes: This is a bounded runtime witness for the single Table 7 P leaf HLAreportFederateLost under IEEE 1516.1-2025 §11.4.1. The fault fixture causes one joined federate to be lost and a subscribed survivor receives the report. It does not prove the universal all-P-leaves requirement by itself; the per-leaf crosswalk tracks the broader inventory and the HLAreportMIMData naming conflict remains unresolved under RL-393.

requirements.source: IEEE 1516.1-2025 §11.4.1, Table 7; pinned Requirements Lab candidate

requirements.statement: The RTI shall publish all leaf interaction classes in Table 7 that are designated with a P.
